nodes.label: Security Review
nodes.author: Claude
nodes.rationale: 1 CRITICAL fixed (UserRead.email EmailStr), 0 HIGH open, 3 MEDIUM, 2 LOW. Auth uses JWT in HttpOnly cookie, Redis JTI blocklist, bcrypt, brute-force protection. SMS/Email 2FA OTP dispatch is unimplemented TODO. Real Gemini API key in local .env (not committed).

nodes.label: Authentication System
nodes.rationale: JWT in HttpOnly cookie (erp_access_token), SameSite=lax, Redis JTI blocklist on logout, bcrypt password hashing, 5 attempts/10min brute-force lockout, TOTP 2FA functional, SMS/Email OTP dispatch TODO.

nodes.label: RBAC Permission System
nodes.rationale: require_permission(module, action) dependency on each endpoint. 35 predefined roles, custom roles via API, access_scopes table with per-scope flags. Superuser bypasses checks. 459 permissions seeded on every backend start.

nodes.label: 2FA OTP Delivery Gap
nodes.rationale: SMS/Email 2FA generates OTP code but dispatch is a TODO in auth.py line ~109. TOTP (authenticator app) works. Users on SMS/Email 2FA cannot complete login.
